title: Hazard Refund Excess: Release Floor Set by the Successor's Declared Intent
content:
For a returned hazard premium on a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts, the declared intent on the loan's maturity case (Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases) that is due and payable or in its extension period sets the hazard release floor.

| Declared intent on that maturity case | Hazard release floor | Effect on a hazard refund excess |
|---|---|---|
| Sell the property | 0.00 (leaving-home release floor) | Any excess above zero is released to the borrower's side |
| Give a deed in lieu | 0.00 (leaving-home release floor) | Any excess above zero is released to the borrower's side |
| Retain the property | 25.00 (retaining release floor) | Released only when it is at least 25.00; a smaller excess stays in the reserve |
| No intent recorded, or no such maturity case | Not set by this rule | — |

Hypothetical check: an excess of 24.99 under a recorded intent to retain stays in the reserve; an excess of 0.01 under a recorded intent to sell is released.
